title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving

claims.claim: Eka Robotics, MIT profesörü Pulkit Agrawal ve eski Google DeepMind araştırmacısı Tuomas Haarnoja tarafından kurulmuştur.

evidence.quote: Founded by MIT professor Pulkit Agrawal and former Google DeepMind researcher Tuomas Haarnoja, the startup just closed an $150 million Series A round that values it at $1.45 billion post-money, led by venture funds a16z and F-Prime.

evidence.quote: Eka says it reliably picks up objects more than 95% of the time.

evidence.quote: Agrawal and Haarnoja, who first met in graduate school at the University of California, Berkeley, are leading researchers in the field of reinforcement learning for robotics control.
